title: spec: describe `branding.logo` as the app's one square icon (1:1, SVG preferred, at least 64 px), per the maintainer's ruling on objectui#12201
body:
Filing gate ③: a task the maintainer directed. It is the objectstack rider of the maintainer's ruling recorded on objectstack-ai/objectui#12201 (2026-10-12, verbatim: 「应用 logo 建议只需要一个尺寸，放在顶部导航的应用名称左侧」, then 「同意」 on the mock). That card's "Where" list carries this rider, verbatim: "Rider, same seat, a small separate PR in objectstack: the `@objectstack/spec` doc on `branding.logo` says "1:1 square app icon, SVG preferred, at least 64 px"; refuse a non-square value if the schema can express it, otherwise doc only."

Reader: objectstack triage (grade and route), then the `domain:spec` seat. New `packages/spec` work belongs to the spec seat, so the `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd`), which dispatched objectstack-ai/objectui#12201, files the rider here instead of carrying it on the objectui card. ⛔ Not a claim.

Dedupe, read at 2026-10-12T09:03Z: the REST issue list of this repo, all states, updated since 2026-10-12T07:00Z, matched against `branding.logo` and `app icon`: 81 scanned, 0 hits. Control: the same scan over objectui hits objectstack-ai/objectui#12201.

## What the ruling asks of the spec

- **One asset.** `branding.logo` is the app's square icon (1:1). Surfaces render it at the size they need: 22 px in the top-bar pill, 22 px in the switcher dropdown, 26 px in the phone drawer, 40 px on marketplace cards. No second asset, no wordmark slot.
- Today, on objectstack `main` `6a40a09`, `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` describes the key as `Custom logo URL for this app` (the `logo` member of the branding schema).
- **The ask:** that description says "1:1 square app icon, SVG preferred, at least 64 px". A non-square value is refused only if the schema can express it. A URL string does not carry its aspect ratio, so this is likely doc-only; the claim measures it.

## Not here

- The objectui half (the top bar draws the icon, the sidebar header goes): objectstack-ai/objectui#12201, dispatched.
- HotCRM's own icon and colour: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2066.
